summary: Verified FINORA SaaS pricing (base+peak*per fee), peak tracking (create bumps, delete keeps peak), platform admin fee column, plan editable inputs, handover reassign flow, and production read-only smoke. Backend pytest 11/11 pass. Frontend selectors and integration all verified. No writes on production.

issues: Hydration warning: devtools instrumentation injects <span> inside <option> (harmless, pre-existing from iteration_9).
Recharts warning 'width(-1) height(-1)' on initial load — container sizing before layout; benign.

critical_code_review_comments: customer_fee() correctly uses track_peak() so peak is monotonic within the month, and fee formula = (base + per*peak)*months is applied identically in /subscription, /platform/tenants and Stripe checkout — good consistency.
checkout_subscription() blocks TRIAL/FREE via `fee.amount<=0` → 409 with clear JA/EN message. Verified.
reassign_clients: is_consultant admin can only hand over from own id (403 otherwise), same from/to → 422, and $pull on secondary_consultant_ids avoids duplicate assignment — solid.
platform_tenants aggregates fee via customer_fee(); loops over all tenants (O(N) DB roundtrips). Consider batching customer_peaks/plans lookup if tenant count grows.
TenantSettings.jsx mounts inside `billing_profile` tab (請求者情報). The user story language ('プラン・お支払い card') implies a dedicated tab; consider renaming or splitting for clearer UX (minor).

HandoverDialog: mine (is_consultant admin) locks `from` to self and shows amber note — correct. For non-consultant admins the `from` select allows any staff, which requires sees_all — enforced server-side.
test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Ephemeral TRIAL signup created per pytest run (cleaned by nature of separate tenant); no prod writes.
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates+deletes 1 client under ryuichi tenant, and one TRIAL signup tenant per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview ryuichi tenant peak this month is now 5 due to test (was 4). Amount shown ¥7,500 on preview until month rollover; formula still 5000+500*peak. Prod demo tenant shows peak 4 / ¥7,000. TenantSettings lives under Settings > 請求者情報 (billing_profile) tab, not a separate プラン tab.
